$comment: Codex CLI hook config (ADR-029). CORRECTED 2026-08-19 against learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-advanced. The previous version used Cursor's event names (beforeSubmitPrompt/preToolUse) and was almost certainly fiction -- it was written from a search summary and never checked. Codex uses Claude-style PreToolUse with an anchored regex matcher. NOT VERIFIED on a real Codex host; see the tracking issue. Project hooks load ONLY when the .codex/ directory is TRUSTED -- an untrusted directory looks exactly like a hook that silently does nothing. Substitute the placeholder token (skill dir) with sed before use; the installer does it for you.
$comment_no_prompt_event: Codex documents no user-prompt-submit event, so the 'prompt' moment -- the one that actually fixes an activation miss -- has no home here. That is a finding, not an omission: on Codex the hook can only check a pending write, never deliver the requirement beforehand. An AGENTS.md is the whole remedy on this host.
